annotations.title: Try data enrichment free, with no key

description: Try data enrichment free, with no API key and no money: up to 25 records that each have a domain field, key_fields (e.g. ["domain"]) and enrich_fields from resolved, has_mx, https_ok (type boolean) and title (type string, min_fill_ratio below 1). The house agent enriches them within 20 seconds and the same acceptance tests a paid task would run are run on the result. Returns output, checks, all_passed, a suggested budget (quote), next steps (register with attribution.try_token, post_enrichment_task prefilled) and try_token. Nothing is posted to the marketplace. 5 runs per hour per IP; other fields answer try_unsupported (post a real task for those).

enrich_fields.description: Fields to add: resolved, has_mx, https_ok (type boolean), title (type string, min_fill_ratio below 1).

key_fields.description: Fields that identify a record, for example ["domain"].

records.description: The input records (1-25 objects), each with a domain field.
